results.justification: Identical defect: extract_connection_ptr returns a borrowed Connection* as a bare Python int (pybridge.py:74) read from offset +32, with no keep-alive/use-after-close contract in the docstring. Current PBR-MEM-1 reports the exact same root cause at the same file:line (latent use-after-free / borrow-contract documentation gap); PBR-SEC-3 also documents the same borrowed-pointer ownership gap. Not stale on the current @proxy tree - the pointer walk and bare-int return survive the migration unchanged.
